Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & audit window

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for agreeing to help onboard Acme for our vendor assurance review. To close our internal assessment we need:

- A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering security and availability) or confirmation of when that report will be available.
- If the Type II report doesn’t fully align with our required period, can you provide a bridge letter that documents the control coverage and the audit period?
- Confirmation of the audit period (start/end dates) and the time zone.

Can you also point us to the recommended minimal evidence bundle (log samples, change control artifacts, SOC 2 mapping) and any secure transfer options?

Prefer a short reply with attachments or a presigned link. If easier, we can accept a presigned S3 link to a zipped package.

Thanks — Liz

Hi Liz —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front:

- Report: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report covering Security + Availability. The latest available report covers 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 (US/Pacific).
- Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter that explains scope, exclusions, and any control changes since the report period. See attached sample.
- Minimal evidence bundle: We typically provide a small starter bundle (audit manifest, sample access logs, change control snapshot, policy index). See the checklist I attached.
- Transfer: presigned S3 link or secure SharePoint transfer works. We prefer presigned S3 for one-off package drops.

I attached a short checklist and three quick reply templates you can reuse when coordinating with your procurement/audit teams. Below are three copy-paste templates if you want them embedded in email: 

1) Quick Acknowledgement (one line)
"Thanks — we received your request. Please expect the SOC 2 package and bridge letter via presigned link within 3 business days. -- Liz"

2) Evidence Follow-up (for specific artifacts)
"We can provide the access logs and change control snapshot for the requested window. Please confirm whether redaction is needed for user identifiers and we will deliver via presigned S3. -- Acme Security Team"

3) Confirmation of Audit Window
"Redwood confirms the SOC 2 Type II coverage period is 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 (PDT). If you need a different window, please list start/end dates and we’ll advise on coverage or mitigation. -- Soojin, Redwood Inference"

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Request_Checklist.pdf; Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx; Quick_Reply_Snippets.txt

Next steps: Kimberly, Marissa — can you prepare the starter bundle and a bridge letter draft? I’ll produce a presigned link once we have the zipped package.

Thanks,
Soojin
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
